column1: # Spoken to written pairs of the A1 road (job 20-a1-road, "Done when" 11).
# One pair per line: spoken word, written word, a short note, separated by a tab.
# A written side of - marks a filler: a spoken only word with no written counterpart.
# A pair needs no line here when the words are equal ignoring case or one ending rule applies
# (scripts/generate/road_mapping.py). Every other pair must be listed, so a reader sees each
# register difference. Words are lower case.
